name: DeviceCard
purpose: Summarize one device: identity, main value, on/off control and health.

elements.header: Icon on the left, control on the right.
elements.icon: Device glyph; filled when the device is on.
elements.control: Toggle placed in the header; its visible track stays inside the padding box.
elements.title: Device name, single line with ellipsis.
elements.unit: Unit suffix; must not grow the value's line box.
elements.status: Dot + text. The only part that changes for abnormal states.

behavior: Abnormal states change only the status row and icon, never the card color (ISA-101).
Offline shows stale values as secondary and disables the control (the one documented exception to status-row-only changes).
Pending adds a spinner after the status text; the status dot stays visible.
A failed command marks the status row critical (data-error) until the next command.
A card is either one tap target (interactive) or contains a control, never both.

a11y.notes: Status is aria-live=polite and always has text, not color alone.

lvgl.notes: Status and active are setters: nn_device_card_set_status(), nn_device_card_set_active().
